intro: Ecuador has about 18 million people from many backgrounds.

chapters.title: People
text: Most Ecuadorians are of mixed descent. Indigenous peoples, including the Kichwa, are a large community, and Afro-Ecuadorians live mainly in Esmeraldas. Spanish is official; Kichwa and Shuar are also official for intercultural relations.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Quito is the capital at 2,850 m; Guayaquil is the biggest city and port.
